```{r}
# =========================
# 3) Load data
# =========================
covs <- rast(covariate_path)
orig_cov_names <- names(covs)
names(covs) <- make.names(orig_cov_names, unique = TRUE)  # safe names
cov_names <- names(covs)

# Chemical points (CID only)
chem <- read.csv(chem_csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(type == "CID")

req_cols <- c("x", "y", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn")
missing_req <- setdiff(req_cols, names(chem))
if (length(missing_req) > 0) stop("Missing chemical columns: ", paste(missing_req, collapse = ", "))

chem_sf <- st_as_sf(chem, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(crs(covs))

# Texture points: join Point_ID (shp) to Point (xlsx)
tex_pts <- st_read(tex_shp_path, quiet = TRUE)
tex_tab <- read_excel(tex_xlsx_path)

if (!("Point_ID" %in% names(tex_pts))) stop("Point_ID not found in perry_full_locs.shp")
if (!("Point" %in% names(tex_tab)))   stop("Point not found in Surface_texture_Perry.xlsx")

tex_join <- tex_pts %>%
  mutate(Point_ID_chr = as.character(Point_ID)) %>%
  left_join(tex_tab %>% mutate(Point_chr = as.character(Point)),
            by = c("Point_ID_chr" = "Point_chr")) %>%
  st_transform(crs(covs)) %>%
  mutate(
    lab_sand = as.numeric(lab_sand),
    lab_silt = as.numeric(lab_silt),
    lab_clay = as.numeric(lab_clay),
    lab_texture_class = as.factor(lab_texture_class)
  )

cat("Texture rows:", nrow(tex_join), "\n")

cat(
  "Texture complete rows (sand/silt/clay):",
  tex_join %>% 
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(complete.cases(lab_sand, lab_silt, lab_clay))) %>% 
    dplyr::pull(n),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 4) RK function
# =========================
run_rk <- function(points_sf, response_col, cov_rast, out_prefix, out_dir, ntrees = 500) {
  cov_names <- names(cov_rast)

  ex <- extract(cov_rast, vect(points_sf), bind = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()

  missing_cov <- setdiff(cov_names, names(ex))
  if (length(missing_cov) > 0) {
    stop("Missing covariates after extraction: ", paste(missing_cov, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dat <- ex %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(response_col), all_of(cov_names))

  # numeric response for continuous RK
  dat[[response_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[response_col]]))
  dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c(response_col, cov_names)]), ]

  cat(response_col, "valid rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")
  if (nrow(dat) < 20) {
    warning(response_col, ": too few complete points (", nrow(dat), "). Skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx <- as.integer(rownames(dat))
  xy <- st_coordinates(points_sf[idx, ])
  dat$x <- xy[,1]
  dat$y <- xy[,2]

  fml <- as.formula(paste(response_col, "~", paste(cov_names, collapse = " + ")))
  rf <- randomForest(fml, data = dat[, c(response_col, cov_names)], ntree = ntrees, importance = TRUE)

  trend_r <- predict(cov_rast, rf, na.rm = TRUE)
  rf_pred_pts <- predict(rf, newdata = dat[, cov_names])
  dat$resid <- dat[[response_col]] - rf_pred_pts

  coordinates(dat) <- ~ x + y
  proj4string(dat) <- CRS(crs(cov_rast, proj = TRUE))

  vgm_fit <- try(autofitVariogram(resid ~ 1, dat), silent = TRUE)

  if (inherits(vgm_fit, "try-error")) {
    rk_r <- trend_r
    krige_var <- trend_r * NA
  } else {
    grd <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(cov_rast[[1]], 1:ncell(cov_rast[[1]])))
    names(grd) <- c("x", "y")
    coordinates(grd) <- ~ x + y
    gridded(grd) <- TRUE
    proj4string(grd) <- CRS(crs(cov_rast, proj = TRUE))

    kr <- krige(resid ~ 1, dat, grd, model = vgm_fit$var_model)
    kr_df <- as.data.frame(kr)

    kr_resid <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.pred), type = "xyz", crs = crs(cov_rast))
    kr_var   <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.var),  type = "xyz", crs = crs(cov_rast))

    kr_resid <- resample(kr_resid, cov_rast[[1]], method = "bilinear")
    kr_var   <- resample(kr_var,   cov_rast[[1]], method = "bilinear")

    rk_r <- trend_r + kr_resid
    krige_var <- kr_var
  }

  writeRaster(rk_r,      file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_RK.tif")),       overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(trend_r,   file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_RFtrend.tif")),  overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(krige_var, file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_krigevar.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 7) Normalize texture to 100%
# =========================
sand <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "texture_Sand_RK.tif"))
silt <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "texture_Silt_RK.tif"))
clay <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "texture_Clay_RK.tif"))

tex_stack <- c(sand, silt, clay)
names(tex_stack) <- c("Sand", "Silt", "Clay")
tex_stack <- clamp(tex_stack, lower = 0, values = TRUE)

sum_tex <- app(tex_stack, sum, na.rm = TRUE)

sand_n <- (tex_stack$Sand / sum_tex) * 100
silt_n <- (tex_stack$Silt / sum_tex) * 100
clay_n <- (tex_stack$Clay / sum_tex) * 100

sand_n[sum_tex == 0] <- NA
silt_n[sum_tex == 0] <- NA
clay_n[sum_tex == 0] <- NA

tex_norm <- c(sand_n, silt_n, clay_n)
names(tex_norm) <- c("Sand_pct", "Silt_pct", "Clay_pct")

writeRaster(tex_norm, file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_RK_normalized.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

sum_check <- app(tex_norm, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
writeRaster(sum_check, file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_sum_check.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

plot(tex_norm)
plot(sum_check, main = "Sand+Silt+Clay (should be ~100)")
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 8) Texture class RF map (optional)
# =========================
ex_t <- extract(covs, vect(tex_join), bind = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()

dat_t <- ex_t %>%
  dplyr::select(lab_texture_class, all_of(names(covs))) %>%
  mutate(lab_texture_class = as.factor(lab_texture_class)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lab_texture_class))

dat_t <- dat_t[complete.cases(dat_t[, c("lab_texture_class", names(covs))]), ]

if (nrow(dat_t) >= 20 && nlevels(dat_t$lab_texture_class) >= 2) {
  rf_cls <- randomForest(lab_texture_class ~ ., data = dat_t[, c("lab_texture_class", names(covs))], ntree = 500)

  cls_r <- predict(covs, rf_cls, type = "response", na.rm = TRUE)
  writeRaster(cls_r, file.path(out_dir, "texture_class_RFclass.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)

  prob_r <- predict(covs, rf_cls, type = "prob", na.rm = TRUE)
  writeRaster(prob_r, file.path(out_dir, "texture_class_RFprobabilities.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# ---------- helper ----------
save_plot_png <- function(r, title_txt, file_png, colr = hcl.colors(24, "Viridis")) {
  png(file_png, width = 2200, height = 1600, res = 220)
  plot(r, main = title_txt, col = colr)
  dev.off()
}

# ---------- 1) RK prediction maps ----------
rk_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "_RK\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(rk_files) > 0) {
  for (f in rk_files) {
    r  <- rast(f)
    nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    plot(r, main = nm, col = hcl.colors(24, "Viridis"))
    save_plot_png(r, nm, file.path(png_dir, paste0(nm, ".png")), colr = hcl.colors(24, "Viridis"))
  }
} else {
  message("No *_RK.tif files found.")
}

# ---------- 2) Kriging variance maps ----------
kv_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "_krigevar\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(kv_files) > 0) {
  for (f in kv_files) {
    r  <- rast(f)
    nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    plot(r, main = nm, col = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrRd"))
    save_plot_png(r, nm, file.path(png_dir, paste0(nm, ".png")), colr = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrRd"))
  }
} else {
  message("No *_krigevar.tif files found.")
}

# ---------- 3) Texture normalized % ----------
tex_norm_path <- file.path(out_dir, "texture_percent_RK_normalized.tif")
if (file.exists(tex_norm_path)) {
  tex_norm <- rast(tex_norm_path)   # Sand_pct, Silt_pct, Clay_pct
  plot(tex_norm, col = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrBr"))
  
  # also save each layer
  for (i in 1:nlyr(tex_norm)) {
    nm <- names(tex_norm)[i]
    save_plot_png(tex_norm[[i]], nm,
                  file.path(png_dir, paste0("texture_", nm, ".png")),
                  colr = hcl.colors(24, "YlOrBr"))
  }
} else {
  message("texture_percent_RK_normalized.tif not found.")
}
```

```{r}
#ordinary kriging for all chemical variables
#| label: ordinary-kriging-no-covars
#| message: true
#| warning: true

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(sp)
library(gstat)
library(automap)

set.seed(123)

# ---------------- paths ----------------
base_dir    <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/data (do not push)"
spatial_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "spatial")

cov_path    <- file.path(spatial_dir, "covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif")
chem_csv    <- file.path(spatial_dir, "soil_points_corrected_with_locations_and_chem.csv")
tex_shp     <- file.path(spatial_dir, "perry_full_locs.shp")
tex_xlsx    <- file.path(base_dir, "Soil data", "Surface_texture_Perry.xlsx")

out_root    <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs"
ok_dir      <- file.path(out_root, "perry_ordinary_kriging_no_covars")
dir.create(ok_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# template raster defines extent/resolution/CRS for prediction
template <- rast(cov_path)[[1]]

# ---------------- load chemical points (CID only) ----------------
chem <- read.csv(chem_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(type == "CID")

chem_sf <- st_as_sf(chem, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(crs(template))

# ---------------- load texture points ----------------
pts <- st_read(tex_shp, quiet = TRUE)
tex <- read_excel(tex_xlsx)

tex_sf <- pts %>%
  mutate(Point_ID_chr = as.character(Point_ID)) %>%
  left_join(tex %>% mutate(Point_chr = as.character(Point)),
            by = c("Point_ID_chr" = "Point_chr")) %>%
  st_transform(crs(template)) %>%
  mutate(
    lab_sand = as.numeric(lab_sand),
    lab_silt = as.numeric(lab_silt),
    lab_clay = as.numeric(lab_clay)
  )

# ---------------- helper: ordinary kriging ----------------
run_ok <- function(points_sf, value_col, out_prefix, template_r, out_dir) {
  df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(points_sf)

  if (!value_col %in% names(df)) {
    warning("Column not found: ", value_col, " (skipping)")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  z <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[value_col]]))
  keep <- is.finite(z)
  if (sum(keep) < 20) {
    warning(value_col, ": too few valid points (", sum(keep), "), skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  pts_use <- points_sf[keep, ]
  xy <- sf::st_coordinates(pts_use)

  d <- data.frame(x = xy[,1], y = xy[,2], z = z[keep])

  # 1) collapse duplicate coordinates by mean (critical for zero-distance semivariance issues)
  d <- d %>%
    group_by(x, y) %>%
    summarise(z = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  if (nrow(d) < 20) {
    warning(value_col, ": too few unique coordinate points after dedup (", nrow(d), ").")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  coordinates(d) <- ~ x + y
  proj4string(d) <- CRS(crs(template_r, proj = TRUE))

  # empirical variogram
  v_emp <- variogram(z ~ 1, d)

  # helper to try fitting a specific model with safer fit.method
  try_fit <- function(model_name) {
    # reasonable initials
    psill0 <- max(var(d$z, na.rm = TRUE), .Machine$double.eps)
    rng0   <- max(diff(range(coordinates(d)[,1]))/4, 1)

    m0 <- vgm(psill = psill0, model = model_name, range = rng0, nugget = psill0 * 0.1)

    fit <- try(fit.variogram(v_emp, model = m0, fit.method = 6), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)
    if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill)) || any(!is.finite(fit$range))) return(NULL)
    fit
  }

  # 2) safer model set (avoid Ste/Mat causing bessel_k issues)
  candidate_models <- c("Exp", "Sph", "Gau")
  v_fit <- NULL
  for (m in candidate_models) {
    v_fit <- try_fit(m)
    if (!is.null(v_fit)) {
      message(value_col, ": fitted variogram model = ", m)
      break
    }
  }

  if (is.null(v_fit)) {
    warning(value_col, ": all variogram fits failed; skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # prediction grid from template extent/resolution
  grd <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(template_r, 1:ncell(template_r)))
  names(grd) <- c("x", "y")
  coordinates(grd) <- ~ x + y
  gridded(grd) <- TRUE
  proj4string(grd) <- CRS(crs(template_r, proj = TRUE))

  kr <- krige(z ~ 1, d, newdata = grd, model = v_fit)

  kr_df <- as.data.frame(kr)
  pred_r <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.pred), type = "xyz", crs = crs(template_r))
  var_r  <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.var),  type = "xyz", crs = crs(template_r))

  pred_r <- resample(pred_r, template_r, method = "bilinear")
  var_r  <- resample(var_r,  template_r, method = "bilinear")

  writeRaster(pred_r, file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_OK.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(var_r,  file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_OKvar.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)

  message("Saved: ", out_prefix)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
# ---------------- run chemical OK ----------------
chem_vars <- c("Mg", "Mn", "P", "K", "Ca", "Zn", "pH.2")
for (v in chem_vars) {
  run_ok(chem_sf, v, paste0("chem_", v), template, ok_dir)
}

# ---------------- run texture OK (continuous only) ----------------
tex_vars <- c("lab_sand", "lab_silt", "lab_clay")
for (v in tex_vars) {
  run_ok(tex_sf, v, paste0("texture_", v), template, ok_dir)
}

# ---------------- normalize texture % to 100 (optional) ----------------
sand_f <- file.path(ok_dir, "texture_lab_sand_OK.tif")
silt_f <- file.path(ok_dir, "texture_lab_silt_OK.tif")
clay_f <- file.path(ok_dir, "texture_lab_clay_OK.tif")

if (file.exists(sand_f) && file.exists(silt_f) && file.exists(clay_f)) {
  sand <- rast(sand_f); silt <- rast(silt_f); clay <- rast(clay_f)

  tex_stack <- c(sand, silt, clay)
  names(tex_stack) <- c("Sand", "Silt", "Clay")
  tex_stack <- clamp(tex_stack, lower = 0, values = TRUE)

  s <- app(tex_stack, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  sand_n <- (tex_stack$Sand / s) * 100
  silt_n <- (tex_stack$Silt / s) * 100
  clay_n <- (tex_stack$Clay / s) * 100
  sand_n[s == 0] <- NA; silt_n[s == 0] <- NA; clay_n[s == 0] <- NA

  tex_norm <- c(sand_n, silt_n, clay_n)
  names(tex_norm) <- c("Sand_pct", "Silt_pct", "Clay_pct")

  sum_check <- app(tex_norm, sum, na.rm = TRUE)

  writeRaster(tex_norm, file.path(ok_dir, "texture_percent_OK_normalized.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
  writeRaster(sum_check, file.path(ok_dir, "texture_percent_OK_sum_check.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
}

cat("\nDone. Ordinary kriging outputs written to:\n", ok_dir, "\n")




```
```{r}
#clip and change to lbs/ac
#| label: clip-and-convert-outputs
#| message: true
#| warning: false

library(terra)

# ---------------- paths ----------------
cov_path <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/data (do not push)/spatial/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif"

# source folder with existing outputs (RK or OK, whichever you want to process)
src_dir <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs/perry_regression_kriging"
# e.g. for OK outputs, use:
# src_dir <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs/perry_ordinary_kriging_no_covars"

out_dir <- file.path(src_dir, "clipped_and_lbsac")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------- template extent ----------------
tmpl <- rast(cov_path)[[1]]  # extent, resolution, CRS template

# ---------------- find rasters ----------------
r_files <- list.files(src_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# avoid recursively reprocessing already-created folder
r_files <- r_files[!grepl("clipped_and_lbsac", r_files, fixed = TRUE)]

# chemical vars to convert (ppm -> lbs/ac)
chem_vars <- c("Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn")

for (f in r_files) {
  r <- rast(f)

  # align geometry to template if needed
  if (!compareGeom(r, tmpl, stopOnError = FALSE, crs = TRUE, ext = FALSE, rowcol = FALSE, res = FALSE)) {
    # only reproject if CRS differs
    if (!same.crs(r, tmpl)) {
      r <- project(r, tmpl, method = "bilinear")
    }
  }

  # clip to covariate extent
  r_clip <- crop(r, tmpl)
  # optional exact mask (same as extent rectangle here, but keeps outside as NA if needed)
  r_clip <- mask(r_clip, tmpl)

  nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  r_out <- r_clip

  # Convert ppm -> lbs/ac for chemical prediction layers only, not pH
  # Applies to names like chem_Ca_RK, chem_P_OK, etc.
  if (grepl("^chem_", nm) && !grepl("pH", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    # ensure one of target analytes is in the filename
    if (any(grepl(paste0("_", chem_vars, "(_|$)"), nm))) {
      r_out <- r_clip * 2
      nm <- paste0(nm, "_lbsac")
    }
  }

  writeRaster(r_out, file.path(out_dir, paste0(nm, ".tif")), overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Saved:", paste0(nm, ".tif"), "\n")
}

cat("\nDone.\nOutput folder:\n", out_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
library(terra)

cov_path <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/data (do not push)/spatial/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif"
src_dir  <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs/perry_ordinary_kriging_no_covars"
out_dir  <- file.path(src_dir, "clipped_and_lbsac")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tmpl <- rast(cov_path)[[1]]

r_files <- list.files(src_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
r_files <- r_files[!grepl("clipped_and_lbsac", r_files, fixed = TRUE)]

for (f in r_files) {
  r <- rast(f)
  nm <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))

  if (!same.crs(r, tmpl)) r <- project(r, tmpl, method = "bilinear")
  r2 <- mask(crop(r, tmpl), tmpl)

  is_chem_ok <- grepl("^chem_", nm) && grepl("_OK$", nm)
  is_ph      <- grepl("pH", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)
  is_var     <- grepl("OKvar$", nm)

  nm_out <- if (is_chem_ok && !is_ph && !is_var) paste0(nm, "_lbsac") else nm
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(nm_out, ".tif"))

  # critical: remove existing file first
  if (file.exists(out_file)) file.remove(out_file)

  writeRaster(r2, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Saved:", out_file, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
#forgot about lbc:
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(sp)
library(gstat)
library(automap)

# ---------- paths ----------
base_dir    <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/data (do not push)"
spatial_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "spatial")

cov_path <- file.path(spatial_dir, "covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif")
chem_csv <- file.path(spatial_dir, "soil_points_corrected_with_locations_and_chem.csv")

out_dir  <- "C:/git/spatial_SCP_taxonomy/outputs/perry_ordinary_kriging_no_covars/clipped_and_lbsac"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

template <- rast(cov_path)[[1]]

# ---------- load chemistry ----------
chem <- read.csv(chem_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(type == "CID")

chem_sf <- st_as_sf(chem, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(crs(template))

# ---------- find lime buffer column ----------
nm <- names(chem_sf)
cand <- nm[grepl("lbc.1", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)]
print(cand)

# set this to the correct column name from print(cand):
lb_col <- cand[1]
if (is.na(lb_col) || length(lb_col) == 0) stop("No lime buffer column found.")

# ---------- build dataset ----------
vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(st_drop_geometry(chem_sf)[[lb_col]]))
keep <- is.finite(vals)
if (sum(keep) < 20) stop("Too few valid Lime Buffer points: ", sum(keep))

pts <- chem_sf[keep, ]
xy  <- st_coordinates(pts)
d   <- data.frame(x = xy[,1], y = xy[,2], z = vals[keep]) %>%
  group_by(x, y) %>%
  summarise(z = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

coordinates(d) <- ~x+y
proj4string(d) <- CRS(crs(template, proj = TRUE))

# ---------- variogram + OK ----------
v_emp <- variogram(z ~ 1, d)

fit_try <- function(model_name) {
  psill0 <- max(var(d$z, na.rm = TRUE), .Machine$double.eps)
  rng0   <- max(diff(range(coordinates(d)[,1])) / 4, 1)
  m0 <- vgm(psill = psill0, model = model_name, range = rng0, nugget = psill0 * 0.1)
  fit <- try(fit.variogram(v_emp, m0, fit.method = 6), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  fit
}

v_fit <- NULL
for (m in c("Exp","Sph","Gau")) {
  v_fit <- fit_try(m)
  if (!is.null(v_fit)) {
    message("Fitted variogram: ", m)
    break
  }
}
if (is.null(v_fit)) stop("Variogram fit failed for Lime Buffer Capacity.")

grd <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(template, 1:ncell(template)))
names(grd) <- c("x","y")
coordinates(grd) <- ~x+y
gridded(grd) <- TRUE
proj4string(grd) <- CRS(crs(template, proj = TRUE))

kr <- krige(z ~ 1, d, grd, model = v_fit)
kr_df <- as.data.frame(kr)

pred <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.pred), type = "xyz", crs = crs(template))
kvar <- rast(cbind(kr_df$x, kr_df$y, kr_df$var1.var),  type = "xyz", crs = crs(template))

pred <- mask(crop(resample(pred, template, method = "bilinear"), template), template)
kvar <- mask(crop(resample(kvar, template, method = "bilinear"), template), template)

# safe file stem
stem <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", lb_col)
f_ok    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("chem_", stem, "_OK.tif"))
f_okvar <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("chem_", stem, "_OKvar.tif"))

if (file.exists(f_ok)) file.remove(f_ok)
if (file.exists(f_okvar)) file.remove(f_okvar)

writeRaster(pred, f_ok, overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(kvar, f_okvar, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Saved:\n", f_ok, "\n", f_okvar, "\n")
```
